title: Dosing Days and Weeks between Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Shipments
content:
**Tailwise Pharmacy dosing calendar — Autoship Pharmacy and Autoship Compounded Pharmacy**

(a) The dosing days between prescription Autoship shipments start from the days of supply one shipment carries: the subscription's package count multiplied by the days one package lasts. One package lasts the linked prescription's days' supply per fill divided by its packages per fill.

(b) The dosing days between shipments leave room for delivery: they are reduced by the program's promised carrier transit days after the ship date.

(c) The weeks between shipments are the dosing days divided by 7 days a week, rounded down to a whole week, and never fewer than the program's shortest frequency nor more than its longest frequency.

## Worked calendar (hypothetical prescriptions; program transit taken as 2 days, frequency range taken as 4 to 26 weeks)

| Prescription per fill | Days one package lasts | Packages per shipment | Days of supply carried | Dosing days after transit | Divided by 7 | Weeks between shipments |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 90 days, 3 packages | 30 | 3 | 90 | 88 | 12.57 | 12 |
| 90 days, 3 packages | 30 | 1 | 30 | 28 | 4 | 4 |
| 30 days, 1 package | 30 | 1 | 30 | 28 | 4 | 4 |
| 56 days, 2 packages | 28 | 1 | 28 | 26 | 3.71 | 4 (raised to the shortest frequency) |
| 360 days, 2 packages | 180 | 2 | 360 | 358 | 51.14 | 26 (held to the longest frequency) |

## Points of judgement

- Rounding is downward and happens once, on the dosing days divided by 7.
- The shortest and longest frequencies are applied after rounding.
- The package count used is the count the subscription carries.
